Job Role : Data & Analytics Leader- Consulting/Managing Partner) (CDO Like )

Location : Toronto, ON (Hybrid)

Experience: 18+ years of experience

Job Type : Full time Permanent

Salary range : CAD $ 140 K/Base +Benifts.

• Experience Range:
18+ years of experience in Data, Analytics & AI, including 10+ years in Data/Application Architecture and 5+ years in Business Development, Presales, Consulting or Growth Leadership roles.

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills:

18+ years of experience in Data, Analytics, AI, Consulting, and Enterprise Data Transformation, with proven success in business growth and large-scale transformation programs.
• Strong expertise in Enterprise Data Strategy, Data Architecture, Operating Models, Data Products, Data Governance, and Data Modernization
• Proven experience in delivering ROI and Business Outcomes to customers across the Data to Insights value chain
• Demonstrates deeper understanding of Data Engineering, including ETL/ELT, data integration, APIs, data quality, orchestration, observability, DataOps, and platform engineering.
• Experience leading Analytics and Business Intelligence initiatives, including enterprise reporting, self-service analytics, semantic layers, advanced analytics, and decision intelligence.
• Strong knowledge of AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps/LLMOps, Responsible AI, and AI-driven business transformation.
• Proven experience defining and delivering enterprise-scale solutions on Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, and modern data platforms.
• Strong understanding of BFSI domain requirements, including regulatory compliance, data privacy, security, resilience, auditability, and risk management.
• Demonstrated success in consulting, business development, pre-sales, solutioning, opportunity qualification, proposal development, pricing support, and executive-level stakeholder management.
• Proven ability to lead large cross-functional teams, drive transformation programs, and engage effectively with CXOs and senior business leaders.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data, Business, or a related discipline.
• Master's Degree or MBA preferred.
• Preferred certifications in Cloud, Enterprise Architecture, Data Management, Analytics, AI, Program Management, or Executive Leadership.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Build trusted relationships with CDOs, CIOs, CAIOs, business executives, and senior technology leaders.
• Advise BFSI clients on enterprise data strategy, analytics transformation, AI adoption, governance, operating models, and modernization priorities.
• Translate business challenges into practical transformation roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes.
• Lead executive workshops, discovery sessions, steering committee discussions, and strategic client conversations.
• Drive growth for Data, Analytics & AI services from opportunity identification and qualification through proposal, negotiation, and closure.
• Shape large consulting and transformation engagements, including solution direction, value proposition, commercial approach, and delivery roadmap.
• Lead RFPs and proactive proposals, ensuring solutions are differentiated, feasible, and outcome-focused.
• Build joint opportunities with account teams, alliance partners, technology providers, and consulting practices.
• Define target-state strategies across cloud data platforms, data products, analytics, AI/ML, GenAI, governance, and responsible AI.
• Recommend practical modernization approaches across Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, and other relevant platforms.
• Ensure transformation decisions address scalability, security, privacy, resilience, cost, and regulatory requirements.
• Provide executive oversight from opportunity shaping and mobilization through delivery and value realization.
• Establish governance across scope, milestones, risks, dependencies, commercial commitments, quality, and stakeholder communication.

jobs.title: Directeur Mondial, Analyses et perspectives/ Global Insights & Analytics Director
jobs.description:
Directeur Mondial, Analyses et perspectives

Montréal, Québec | Secteur mondial des activités minières

L’opportunité:

Avez-vous toujours souhaité travailler à la croisée du marketing et des analyses, tout en bâtissant d’excellentes relations au sein d’une entreprise de classe mondiale ?
À titre de chef de file mondial de la mobilité et de l’innovation, nous recherchons une personne stratégique, axée sur la clientèle et spécialisée en analytique marketing afin de contribuer à notre transformation fondée sur les données dans l’ensemble du secteur minier mondial. Il s’agit d’une occasion à fort impact pour une personne qui combine connaissance du marché, intelligence d’affaires et analytique afin de transformer des renseignements complexes en stratégies claires, en valeur accrue pour la clientèle et en résultats d’affaires mesurables.
Ce poste de contributeur individuel relève de l’organisation Marketing Mines et collabore avec les équipes Stratégie, Ventes, Opérations, Qualité, régionales et centrales, ainsi qu’avec des clients stratégiques. Le poste est situé à notre siège social Canadien, au centre-ville de Montréal, près de la station de métro Peel.

Vos responsabilités :

La personne titulaire du poste élaborera la vision à long terme visant à tirer parti de l’analytique marketing et des perspectives. Elle reliera la compréhension des clients et du marché aux données. Elle aidera également l’entreprise à prioriser et à mettre en œuvre les occasions qui créent le plus de valeur. Les principales responsabilités comprennent :

Élaborer et prendre en charge une feuille de route quinquennale à décennale pour les activités minières, alignée sur la stratégie d’affaires et les besoins des clients.
Transformer les données sur les clients, le marché et les opérations en plans marketing clairs, en recommandations stratégiques et en récits convaincants pour les décideurs.
Collaborer avec les clients et les équipes internes afin de coconstruire des solutions, de clarifier les besoins d’affaires et de convertir les perspectives en projets et décisions concrets.
Orienter l’utilisation de l’analytique avancée et de l’intelligence artificielle en formulant les questions d’affaires, en évaluant les résultats et en veillant à ce que les solutions soient utiles, compréhensibles et adoptées.
Soutenir les priorités en matière de gouvernance et de qualité des données, et contribuer, avec l’équipe Stratégie et d’autres parties prenantes, aux recommandations visant à développer, à établir un partenariat ou à acheter des solutions.

Ce que vous apporterez :

Une maîtrise ou un diplôme d’études supérieures en marketing, en gestion, en analytique, en génie, en science des données, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe est préférable.
Environ cinq à dix ans d’expérience en analytique marketing, en gestion des revenus, en tarification, en analytique d’affaires avancée, en intelligence de marché ou dans un environnement d’affaires similaire à forte intensité analytique sont particulièrement valorisés.
Expérience démontrée dans l’élaboration de feuilles de route en analytique ou en perspectives, ainsi que dans la conversion des données en stratégie marketing, en valeur pour la clientèle ou en résultats d’affaires mesurables.
Expérience démontrée dans l’influence de parties prenantes de niveau supérieur, mondiales et interfonctionnelles au sein d’une organisation matricielle.

Excellentes aptitudes en narration, en communication avec la haute direction et en présentation, y compris la capacité de rendre des renseignements complexes clairs et exploitables.
Orientation vers les résultats, innovation, agilité d’apprentissage et capacité de passer de la perspective à la mise en œuvre.
Agir comme lien entre les parties prenantes d’affaires, les équipes d’analytique, les architectes de données et les experts techniques, afin que les capacités analytiques avancées se traduisent en décisions d’affaires concrètes.
Compréhension des méthodes d’analytique avancée, de la modélisation prédictive, des cadres d’intelligence d’affaires et des processus de prise de décision analytique.
Compétences linguistiques : La maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, principalement à l’oral et idéalement à l’écrit, est essentielle pour communiquer efficacement avec les parties prenantes internationales.

Disponibilité à modifier occasionnellement les heures de travail afin de participer à des réunions virtuelles dans différents fuseaux horaires.
Capacité et volonté de voyager au Canada et à l’étranger environ une fois tous les deux mois.
Une aide à la relocalisation est offerte.

À quoi ressemble la réussite :

Au cours des trois premiers mois, développer une compréhension des besoins des clients du secteur minier, de l’écosystème de données et des principaux partenaires internes. Proposer des gains rapides et concrets qui créent de la valeur pour les clients et Michelin.
Au cours de la première année, établir une feuille de route à long terme harmonisée, prioriser les cas d’usage assortis d’une valeur claire et de plans d’adoption, et démontrer des progrès vers des résultats mesurables pour les clients et l’entreprise.
Gagner en crédibilité auprès des fonctions et des régions en combinant compréhension du marché, jugement analytique, collaboration et communication claire.

Global Insights & Analytics Director

Montreal, Quebec | Global Mining Business

The opportunity:

Have you ever wanted to be involved in both marketing and insights, all while building great relationships and working for a world-class company?
As a global leader in mobility and innovation, we are looking for a strategic, customer-focused marketing analytics professional
to help shape our data-driven transformation across the global mining business! This is a high-impact opportunity for someone who combines marketing insight, business intelligence and analytics to turn complex information into clear strategies, stronger customer value and measurable business results.
This individual-contributor role will report within the Mining Marketing organization and work across Strategy, Sales, Operations, Quality, regional and central teams, and strategic customers. This position is based in our Canadian Head Office located in downtown Montreal (PEEL Metro).

What You'll Do:

This role will develop the long-term vision for extracting marketing analytics and insights. It will connect customer and market understanding with data. The role will also help the business prioritize and implement opportunities that develop the greatest value. Key responsibilities include:

Develop and own a 5-to-10-year Mining roadmap aligned with business strategy and customer needs.
Translate customer, market and operational data into clear marketing plans, strategic recommendations and compelling stories for decision-makers.
Partner with customers and internal teams to co-create solutions, clarify business needs and turn insights into practical projects and decisions.
Guide the use of advanced analytics and AI by framing business questions, evaluating outputs and ensuring solutions are useful, understandable and adopted.
Support data governance and quality priorities and contribute to build, partner or buy recommendations with Strategy and other stakeholders.

What You Will Bring:

A master's degree or advanced degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science or a related field is preferred.
Approximately 5-10 years of experience in marketing analytics, revenue management, pricing, advanced business analytics, market intelligence or similarly analytics-intensive business environments is particularly valued.
Demonstrated experience building analytics or insights roadmaps and converting data into marketing strategy, customer value or measurable business results.
Experience with influencing senior, global and cross-functional stakeholders in a matrixed organization
.
Strong storytelling, executive communication and presentation skills, including the ability to make complex information clear and actionable.
Results orientation, innovation, learning agility and the ability to move from insight to implementation.
Serve as the bridge between business stakeholders, analytics teams, data architects and technical experts, ensuring advanced analytical capabilities are translated into actionable business decisions.
Understanding of advanced analytics methodologies, predictive modeling, business intelligence frameworks and analytical decision-making processes.
Language Skills:
Proficiency in French and English—primarily spoken and ideally written—is essential for effective communication with international stakeholders.
Willingness to occasionally adjust working hours to participate in virtual meetings across different time zones.
Ability and willingness to travel (domestic and international) approximately once every two months.
Relocation assistance available.

What Success Looks Like:

During the first three months, develop an understanding of mining customer needs, the data ecosystem, and key internal partners. Propose practical quick wins that bring value to customers and Michelin.
Within the first year, establish an aligned long-term roadmap, prioritize use cases with clear value and adoption plans, and demonstrate progress toward measurable customer and business outcomes.
Earn credibility across functions and regions by combining market understanding, analytical judgment, collaboration and clear communication.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Raw Materials Innovation - Materials & Technology
jobs.description:
Requirements

Description & Requirements

who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well.

At lululemon, we set audacious goals, nurture big growth, and engineer products that help our guests feel and perform their best. Leadership is more than a role or title here - it is a way of being. We are all leaders, committed to growth, results, and creating a future that would not exist without us.

We are looking for people who unite diverse perspectives, challenge what is possible, and bring bold ideas to life with courage, curiosity, creativity, and care.

About This Team

The Raw Materials Innovation team shapes, surprises, and engineers delight into the future guest experience through advanced innovation principles, material science, manufacturing knowledge, and deep supply-chain partnership.

We go beyond traditional research and development. We innovate early in the value chain - across monomer, fiber, yarn, fabric, textile construction, machinery, manufacturing process, and commercialization pathways - to create materials and experiences our guests may not yet know they want.

We create new materials that did not exist. We enable new manufacturing techniques. We engineer new sensations, performance benefits, and functionality into our materials. We lead the industry in bringing sustainable solves to the materials that we use. Our work spans short-, mid-, and long-term horizons by defining the state of the art, leading research, building insight, generating unique points of view, creating prototypes, proving principles, protecting intellectual property, and taking innovation all the way to commercialization.

About This Role

We are looking for a visionary innovation leader, technical expert, and organizational builder to shape the future of Raw Materials Innovation at lululemon.

This role is accountable for establishing lululemon's long-term Raw Materials Innovation strategy, advancing next-generation materials and manufacturing technologies, and building the organizational capabilities that will sustain our leadership in performance apparel for years to come.

As the senior leader for Raw Materials Innovation, you will oversee a multi-horizon innovation portfolio spanning near-term commercialization opportunities, mid-term material platform developments, and long-term breakthrough technologies. You will guide how we explore emerging technologies, invest in innovation capabilities, develop strategic partnerships, and create differentiated materials and manufacturing solutions that deliver meaningful guest benefits.

This role will also lead the creation and evolution of a world-class Raw Materials Prototype Innovation Lab, accelerating experimentation, learning, prototyping, testing, and commercialization readiness across the innovation ecosystem.

Success requires a unique blend of strategic thinking, technical expertise, business acumen, and people leadership. You understand how fiber, yarn, fabric structure, machine parameters, manufacturing processes, and supply chain capabilities come together to create differentiated product experiences. You are equally comfortable working through complex technical challenges, influencing executive decision-making, and building high-performing teams.

You will collaborate with global suppliers, mills, machinery manufacturers, technology companies, research institutions, startups, and cross-functional partners to identify future opportunities, shape innovation roadmaps, and translate emerging technologies into scalable business impact.

a day in the life

Every day in this role is dynamic, technical, creative, and deeply connected to the future of the business.

You may begin your day by connecting with a machinery manufacturer in Europe, a technology company in Japan, a supplier partner in Taiwan, or a research institute working on a new fiber, yarn, textile construction, or manufacturing process.

You move from there into the lab, where you are reviewing trials, checking equipment performance, challenging assumptions, and working with your team to understand why a material behaved in an unexpected way. You look at the data, touch the material, test the prototype, ask better questions, and push for the next iteration.

Later, you partner with Product Innovation, Design, Raw Materials Development, Sourcing, Quality, Legal, and Commercialization teams to translate a breakthrough into something that can scale. You may help define an IP strategy, evaluate a trade-off between performance and cost, or pressure-test whether an emerging material platform can realistically move from bench to pilot to commercial production.

In the afternoon, you may be in a technical review with a machinery manufacturer, exploring how to modify a sampling machine to create a new textile structure, improve productivity, reduce waste, or unlock a new material sensation.

By the end of the day, you have advanced an idea, solved a technical problem, protected a future advantage, and moved lululemon one step closer to creating materials the world has not seen before.

Key Responsibilities

Lead future technology and materials manufacturing innovation

Lead innovation across fiber, yarn, fabric construction, textile manufacturing, machine process development, and scalable material platforms.
Translate guest needs, athlete insights, business opportunities, and technical constraints into material innovation platforms.
Use deep understanding of structure-property-processing relationships to design materials with clear performance intent, including moisture management, stretch and recovery, breathability, thermal comfort, durability, abrasion resistance, handfeel, drape, and lightweight performance.
Create new material concepts from early hypothesis through proof of concept, prototype, pilot, and first commercial production.
Develop innovation roadmaps that connect short-term product opportunities with mid- and long-term technology platforms.
Identify and solve technical problems at the source by working directly with suppliers, mills, machinery partners, and technology companies.
Build material platforms, not only one-off developments, so innovation can scale across multiple product lines and franchises.
Lead platform-level projects from idea through trialing, testing, validation, costing, commercialization, and post-launch learning.
Develop commercialization roadmaps that include pilot trials, risk assessments, cost targets, supply readiness, testing gates, and decision points.
Identify and resolve scale-up risks early, including equipment limitations, quality variation, production yield, process windows, raw material availability, cost, and capacity.
Take accountability beyond proof of concept and support first commercial production so innovation is delivered with quality, consistency, and business impact.

Collaborate with global machinery manufacturers and technology companies

Build and lead a global ecosystem of machinery manufacturers, technology companies, research institutions, suppliers, mills, startups, universities, laboratories, and technical experts to accelerate innovation and unlock future material capabilities.
Influence external innovation roadmaps and strategic partnerships to advance lululemon's material and manufacturing priorities.
Structure and lead collaborative innovation programs that create meaningful competitive advantage while appropriately protecting lululemon's intellectual property, knowledge, and strategic interests.
Represent lululemon externally through industry forums, innovation consortiums, research collaborations, and executive-level partner engagements.

Build and run a world-class Raw Materials Prototype Innovation & Testing Lab

Build and evolve a world-class Raw Materials Innovation Lab, including strategy, capability roadmap, operating model, governance, and future investment priorities.
Ensure the lab accelerates experimentation, prototyping, technical learning, testing, and commercialization readiness.
Establish frameworks, processes, and standards that enable scalable, repeatable, and commercially relevant innovation.
Prioritize investments in equipment, emerging technologies, testing capabilities, and external partnerships that expand innovation capabilities.
Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation, scientific rigor, safety, and continuous learning.
Maintain a robust library of innovation trials, material developments, prototypes, test results, learnings, and decision records.
Recruit, train, coach, and develop lab technicians, interns, specialists, and external experts who can support specialized machinery and trial development.

Strengthen technical rigor, testing, and IP protection

Establish technical validation frameworks that ensure innovation platforms are supported by rigorous testing, material characterization, manufacturing trials, and evidence-based decision making.
Analyze technical learnings, identify opportunities and risks, and translate insights into scalable innovation solutions.
Ensure innovation work is documented with the rigor required to support commercialization, repeatability, and organizational learning.
Partner with Legal and cross-functional leaders to identify, protect, and maximize intellectual property opportunities.
Build a culture where technical decisions balance scientific rigor, commercial pragmatism, and long-term strategic value.

Lead people, culture, and cross-functional partnership

Build and lead a high-performing innovation organization, including managers, senior technical leaders, scientists, innovators and specialized technical experts that values curiosity, hands-on making, scientific rigor, courage, speed, humility and accountability
Lead through organizational complexity and influence across multiple teams, functions, regions, and external partner networks
Mentor the next generation of material innovators and create space for bold thinking grounded in strong execution.
Create an inclusive innovation culture that attracts, develops, and retains world-class technical talent globally
Educate cross-functional partners on how materials create feel, function, performance, and differentiation.
Partner with Product Innovation, Design, Raw Materials Development, Merchandising, Sourcing, Quality, Legal, and Vendor Partners to build Raw Materials strategic roadmaps.
Represent Raw Materials Innovation internally and externally as a thought leader in advanced textiles, manufacturing innovation, and material platforms.

What Success Looks Like

A robust multi-year innovation portfolio consistently delivers both near-term business impact and long-term strategic differentiation.
Raw Materials Innovation is recognized as a strategic capability that influences enterprise decision-making and future product strategy.
The Raw Materials Innovation Lab becomes a trusted engine for faster learning, better prototypes, and stronger commercialization decisions.
lululemon creates material platforms that are differentiated, scalable, and difficult for competitors to replicate.
Innovation moves faster from idea to proof of concept and from proof of concept to first commercial production.
New materials deliver clear guest-perceivable benefits in feel, function, performance, durability, or comfort.
Partnerships with machinery manufacturers, technology companies, mills, labs, and research institutions create meaningful technical advantage.
Material innovations are supported by strong data, clear testing, well-managed risk, and appropriate IP protection.
lululemon is recognized externally as a leader in advanced materials and manufacturing innovation.

Qualifications

Master's degree or PhD preferred in Textile Engineering, Materials Science,

jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Sciences
jobs.description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.

Job Title
: Associate Director, Data Sciences

Location:
Mississauga, Ontario, Canada

Work Model:
Hybrid

Who We Are 

It all started with a classic story about one developer’s vision. In 1995, Carl Rodrigues, President and CEO of SOTI, has developed solutions for managing mobile device screens from a desktop. An innovation that has put him ahead in what is now one of the largest growing markets – Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM). Today, more than 17,000 enterprise customers around the world depend on us to secure, manage, and support their mobile operations, with millions of devices managed worldwide.

SOTI’s two decades of success has built strong partnerships with leading mobile platform providers and device manufacturers. We are deeply committed to researching and developing solutions that address today’s toughest mobility challenges. We strive to go where nobody has gone before.

What’s In It for You? 

The People - From our humble origins in our founder’s basement to our industry-leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation, and fun.  

The Growth - Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big! 

The Technology - You’ll get the chance to work with leading-edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners, which include leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies. 

What We’re Looking For

As Associate Director of Data Sciences, you will spearhead the strategic direction of AI and data intelligence initiatives at SOTI, transforming complex data challenges into enterprise-wide innovations that drive competitive advantage and long-term growth.

Reporting to senior leadership, you'll oversee the evolution of our data science capabilities, ensuring alignment with business objectives while mentoring high-calibre teams to deliver transformative AI solutions.

What You’ll Do

Spearhead the Data Science function responsible for developing and delivering AI-driven capabilities across SOTI’s product portfolio.
Define, execute, and continually refine the enterprise-wide AI strategy, integrating machine learning, advanced analytics, and data intelligence to optimize product capabilities, enhance customer outcomes, and boost operational efficiency across SOTI’s global portfolio.
Stay current with emerging developments in artificial intelligence and machine learning and translate them into practical innovations that strengthen SOTI’s competitive position.
Partner closely with Product Management and Development teams to embed predictive insights, anomaly detection, and automation into SOTI One product constituents.
Guide and mentor a team of data scientists and ML engineers, fostering a culture of experimentation, innovation, and delivery excellence.
Drive the development of scalable machine learning pipelines and data platforms capable of processing large-scale device telemetry and operational data.
Collaborate with engineering teams to operationalize models in production environments using modern MLOps practices.
Proactively identify and prioritize AI opportunities through market analysis and stakeholder alignment, leveraging analytics for advanced product intelligence, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and actionable operational insights that deliver measurable ROI for enterprise customers.
Advise executive leadership on AI trends, risks, and investment priorities, crafting roadmaps that align data science initiatives with SOTI’s long-term business goals and regulatory landscape.

Experience You’ll Bring

Graduate degree in computer science, software engineering, applied mathematics, data science, statistics, or other related field
10+ years in analytics, data science, or related fields, with 5+ years in senior leadership roles overseeing cross-functional teams and strategic AI implementations.
Strong communication and leadership skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex analytical concepts into product value.
Proven experience delivering machine learning capabilities within production SaaS or enterprise software products.
Strong understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning, and modern AI techniques including supervised learning, anomaly detection, time-series analysis, and deep learning.
Demonstrated experience in strategic planning, including developing AI roadmaps, budgeting for data science initiatives, and evaluating partnerships or acquisitions to accelerate innovation.
Experience working with large-scale data platforms and cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services.
Experience building production-grade ML pipelines including model training, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Experience working with large telemetry datasets, distributed data processing systems, or real-time analytics platforms is considered an asset.

About SOTI

SOTI is the world's most trusted provider of mobile and IoT management solutions, with more than 17,000 enterprise customers and millions of devices managed worldwide. SOTI's innovative portfolio of solutions and services provides the tools organizations need to mobilize their operations and optimize their mobility investments.

SOTI extends secure mobility management to provide a flexible solution for comprehensive management and security of all mobile devices and connected peripherals deployed in an organization.

At SOTI, we celebrate the uniqueness of our global teams and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are curious problem solvers who are committed to bringing the best mobile and IoT management solutions to the market. We offer careers with #EndlessPossibilities.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring

SOTI uses AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing resumes, screening qualifications, and creating interview questions. These tools assist our team only-final hiring decisions are made by people, not automation. For privacy-related questions, please contact privacy@soti.net
.

We are committed to providing accessible employment practices that are in compliance with the requirements under the Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please notify People & Culture at careers@soti.net
.

Please note that SOTI does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Services Agreement with agency/recruiter, SOTI will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee.

Soutenir les priorités en matière de gouvernance et de qualité des données, et contribuer, avec l’équipe Stratégie et d’autres parties prenantes, aux recommandations visant à développer, à établir un partenariat ou à acheter des solutions.

Ce que vous apporterez :

Une maîtrise ou un diplôme d’études supérieures en marketing, en gestion, en analytique, en génie, en science des données, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe est préférable.
Environ cinq à dix ans d’expérience en analytique marketing, en gestion des revenus, en tarification, en analytique d’affaires avancée, en intelligence de marché ou dans un environnement d’affaires similaire à forte intensité analytique sont particulièrement valorisés.
Expérience démontrée dans l’élaboration de feuilles de route en analytique ou en perspectives, ainsi que dans la conversion des données en stratégie marketing, en valeur pour la clientèle ou en résultats d’affaires mesurables.
Expérience démontrée dans l’influence de parties prenantes de niveau supérieur, mondiales et interfonctionnelles au sein d’une organisation matricielle.

Excellentes aptitudes en narration, en communication avec la haute direction et en présentation, y compris la capacité de rendre des renseignements complexes clairs et exploitables.
Orientation vers les résultats, innovation, agilité d’apprentissage et capacité de passer de la perspective à la mise en œuvre.
Agir comme lien entre les parties prenantes d’affaires, les équipes d’analytique, les architectes de données et les experts techniques, afin que les capacités analytiques avancées se traduisent en décisions d’affaires concrètes.
Compréhension des méthodes d’analytique avancée, de la modélisation prédictive, des cadres d’intelligence d’affaires et des processus de prise de décision analytique.
Compétences linguistiques : La maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, principalement à l’oral et idéalement à l’écrit, est essentielle pour communiquer efficacement avec les parties prenantes internationales.

Disponibilité à modifier occasionnellement les heures de travail afin de participer à des réunions virtuelles dans différents fuseaux horaires.
Capacité et volonté de voyager au Canada et à l’étranger environ une fois tous les deux mois.
Une aide à la relocalisation est offerte.

À quoi ressemble la réussite :

Au cours des trois premiers mois, développer une compréhension des besoins des clients du secteur minier, de l’écosystème de données et des principaux partenaires internes. Proposer des gains rapides et concrets qui créent de la valeur pour les clients et Michelin.
Au cours de la première année, établir une feuille de route à long terme harmonisée, prioriser les cas d’usage assortis d’une valeur claire et de plans d’adoption, et démontrer des progrès vers des résultats mesurables pour les clients et l’entreprise.
Gagner en crédibilité auprès des fonctions et des régions en combinant compréhension du marché, jugement analytique, collaboration et communication claire.

Global Insights & Analytics Director

Montreal, Quebec | Global Mining Business

The opportunity:

Have you ever wanted to be involved in both marketing and insights, all while building great relationships and working for a world-class company?
As a global leader in mobility and innovation, we are looking for a strategic, customer-focused marketing analytics professional
to help shape our data-driven transformation across the global mining business! This individual-contributor role will report within the Mining Marketing organization and work across Strategy, Sales, Operations, Quality, regional and central teams, and strategic customers. This position is based in our Canadian Head Office located in downtown Montreal (PEEL Metro).

What You'll Do:

This role will develop the long-term vision for extracting marketing analytics and insights. It will connect customer and market understanding with data. The role will also help the business prioritize and implement opportunities that develop the greatest value. Key responsibilities include:

Develop and own a 5-to-10-year Mining roadmap aligned with business strategy and customer needs.
Translate customer, market and operational data into clear marketing plans, strategic recommendations and compelling stories for decision-makers.
Partner with customers and internal teams to co-create solutions, clarify business needs and turn insights into practical projects and decisions.
Guide the use of advanced analytics and AI by framing business questions, evaluating outputs and ensuring solutions are useful, understandable and adopted.

What You Will Bring:

Approximately 5-10 years of experience in marketing analytics, revenue management, pricing, advanced business analytics, market intelligence or similarly analytics-intensive business environments is particularly valued.
Demonstrated experience building analytics or insights roadmaps and converting data into marketing strategy, customer value or measurable business results.
Experience with influencing senior, global and cross-functional stakeholders in a matrixed organization
.

Results orientation, innovation, learning agility and the ability to move from insight to implementation.
Serve as the bridge between business stakeholders, analytics teams, data architects and technical experts, ensuring advanced analytical capabilities are translated into actionable business decisions.
Understanding of advanced analytics methodologies, predictive modeling, business intelligence frameworks and analytical decision-making processes.
Language Skills:
Proficiency in French and English—primarily spoken and ideally written—is essential for effective communication with international stakeholders.
Willingness to occasionally adjust working hours to participate in virtual meetings across different time zones.
Ability and willingness to travel (domestic and international) approximately once every two months.
Relocation assistance available.

What Success Looks Like:

During the first three months, develop an understanding of mining customer needs, the data ecosystem, and key internal partners. Propose practical quick wins that bring value to customers and Michelin.
Within the first year, establish an aligned long-term roadmap, prioritize use cases with clear value and adoption plans, and demonstrate progress toward measurable customer and business outcomes.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Raw Materials Innovation - Materials & Technology
new_jobs.description:
Requirements

Description & Requirements

who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well.

At lululemon, we set audacious goals, nurture big growth, and engineer products that help our guests feel and perform their best. Leadership is more than a role or title here - it is a way of being. We are all leaders, committed to growth, results, and creating a future that would not exist without us.

We are looking for people who unite diverse perspectives, challenge what is possible, and bring bold ideas to life with courage, curiosity, creativity, and care.

About This Team

The Raw Materials Innovation team shapes, surprises, and engineers delight into the future guest experience through advanced innovation principles, material science, manufacturing knowledge, and deep supply-chain partnership.

We go beyond traditional research and development. We innovate early in the value chain - across monomer, fiber, yarn, fabric, textile construction, machinery, manufacturing process, and commercialization pathways - to create materials and experiences our guests may not yet know they want.

We create new materials that did not exist. We enable new manufacturing techniques. We engineer new sensations, performance benefits, and functionality into our materials. We lead the industry in bringing sustainable solves to the materials that we use. Our work spans short-, mid-, and long-term horizons by defining the state of the art, leading research, building insight, generating unique points of view, creating prototypes, proving principles, protecting intellectual property, and taking innovation all the way to commercialization.

About This Role

We are looking for a visionary innovation leader, technical expert, and organizational builder to shape the future of Raw Materials Innovation at lululemon.

This role is accountable for establishing lululemon's long-term Raw Materials Innovation strategy, advancing next-generation materials and manufacturing technologies, and building the organizational capabilities that will sustain our leadership in performance apparel for years to come.

As the senior leader for Raw Materials Innovation, you will oversee a multi-horizon innovation portfolio spanning near-term commercialization opportunities, mid-term material platform developments, and long-term breakthrough technologies. You will guide how we explore emerging technologies, invest in innovation capabilities, develop strategic partnerships, and create differentiated materials and manufacturing solutions that deliver meaningful guest benefits.

This role will also lead the creation and evolution of a world-class Raw Materials Prototype Innovation Lab, accelerating experimentation, learning, prototyping, testing, and commercialization readiness across the innovation ecosystem.

Success requires a unique blend of strategic thinking, technical expertise, business acumen, and people leadership. You understand how fiber, yarn, fabric structure, machine parameters, manufacturing processes, and supply chain capabilities come together to create differentiated product experiences. You are equally comfortable working through complex technical challenges, influencing executive decision-making, and building high-performing teams.

You will collaborate with global suppliers, mills, machinery manufacturers, technology companies, research institutions, startups, and cross-functional partners to identify future opportunities, shape innovation roadmaps, and translate emerging technologies into scalable business impact.

a day in the life

Every day in this role is dynamic, technical, creative, and deeply connected to the future of the business.

You may begin your day by connecting with a machinery manufacturer in Europe, a technology company in Japan, a supplier partner in Taiwan, or a research institute working on a new fiber, yarn, textile construction, or manufacturing process.

You move from there into the lab, where you are reviewing trials, checking equipment performance, challenging assumptions, and working with your team to understand why a material behaved in an unexpected way. You look at the data, touch the material, test the prototype, ask better questions, and push for the next iteration.

Later, you partner with Product Innovation, Design, Raw Materials Development, Sourcing, Quality, Legal, and Commercialization teams to translate a breakthrough into something that can scale. You may help define an IP strategy, evaluate a trade-off between performance and cost, or pressure-test whether an emerging material platform can realistically move from bench to pilot to commercial production.

In the afternoon, you may be in a technical review with a machinery manufacturer, exploring how to modify a sampling machine to create a new textile structure, improve productivity, reduce waste, or unlock a new material sensation.

By the end of the day, you have advanced an idea, solved a technical problem, protected a future advantage, and moved lululemon one step closer to creating materials the world has not seen before.

Key Responsibilities

Lead future technology and materials manufacturing innovation

Lead innovation across fiber, yarn, fabric construction, textile manufacturing, machine process development, and scalable material platforms.
Translate guest needs, athlete insights, business opportunities, and technical constraints into material innovation platforms.
Use deep understanding of structure-property-processing relationships to design materials with clear performance intent, including moisture management, stretch and recovery, breathability, thermal comfort, durability, abrasion resistance, handfeel, drape, and lightweight performance.
Create new material concepts from early hypothesis through proof of concept, prototype, pilot, and first commercial production.
Develop innovation roadmaps that connect short-term product opportunities with mid- and long-term technology platforms.
Identify and solve technical problems at the source by working directly with suppliers, mills, machinery partners, and technology companies.
Build material platforms, not only one-off developments, so innovation can scale across multiple product lines and franchises.
Lead platform-level projects from idea through trialing, testing, validation, costing, commercialization, and post-launch learning.
Develop commercialization roadmaps that include pilot trials, risk assessments, cost targets, supply readiness, testing gates, and decision points.
Identify and resolve scale-up risks early, including equipment limitations, quality variation, production yield, process windows, raw material availability, cost, and capacity.
Take accountability beyond proof of concept and support first commercial production so innovation is delivered with quality, consistency, and business impact.

Collaborate with global machinery manufacturers and technology companies

Build and lead a global ecosystem of machinery manufacturers, technology companies, research institutions, suppliers, mills, startups, universities, laboratories, and technical experts to accelerate innovation and unlock future material capabilities.
Influence external innovation roadmaps and strategic partnerships to advance lululemon's material and manufacturing priorities.
Structure and lead collaborative innovation programs that create meaningful competitive advantage while appropriately protecting lululemon's intellectual property, knowledge, and strategic interests.
Represent lululemon externally through industry forums, innovation consortiums, research collaborations, and executive-level partner engagements.

Build and run a world-class Raw Materials Prototype Innovation & Testing Lab

Build and evolve a world-class Raw Materials Innovation Lab, including strategy, capability roadmap, operating model, governance, and future investment priorities.
Ensure the lab accelerates experimentation, prototyping, technical learning, testing, and commercialization readiness.
Establish frameworks, processes, and standards that enable scalable, repeatable, and commercially relevant innovation.
Prioritize investments in equipment, emerging technologies, testing capabilities, and external partnerships that expand innovation capabilities.
Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation, scientific rigor, safety, and continuous learning.
Maintain a robust library of innovation trials, material developments, prototypes, test results, learnings, and decision records.
Recruit, train, coach, and develop lab technicians, interns, specialists, and external experts who can support specialized machinery and trial development.

Strengthen technical rigor, testing, and IP protection

Establish technical validation frameworks that ensure innovation platforms are supported by rigorous testing, material characterization, manufacturing trials, and evidence-based decision making.
Analyze technical learnings, identify opportunities and risks, and translate insights into scalable innovation solutions.
Ensure innovation work is documented with the rigor required to support commercialization, repeatability, and organizational learning.
Partner with Legal and cross-functional leaders to identify, protect, and maximize intellectual property opportunities.
Build a culture where technical decisions balance scientific rigor, commercial pragmatism, and long-term strategic value.

Lead people, culture, and cross-functional partnership

Build and lead a high-performing innovation organization, including managers, senior technical leaders, scientists, innovators and specialized technical experts that values curiosity, hands-on making, scientific rigor, courage, speed, humility and accountability
Lead through organizational complexity and influence across multiple teams, functions, regions, and external partner networks
Mentor the next generation of material innovators and create space for bold thinking grounded in strong execution.
Create an inclusive innovation culture that attracts, develops, and retains world-class technical talent globally
Educate cross-functional partners on how materials create feel, function, performance, and differentiation.
Partner with Product Innovation, Design, Raw Materials Development, Merchandising, Sourcing, Quality, Legal, and Vendor Partners to build Raw Materials strategic roadmaps.
Represent Raw Materials Innovation internally and externally as a thought leader in advanced textiles, manufacturing innovation, and material platforms.

What Success Looks Like

A robust multi-year innovation portfolio consistently delivers both near-term business impact and long-term strategic differentiation.
Raw Materials Innovation is recognized as a strategic capability that influences enterprise decision-making and future product strategy.
The Raw Materials Innovation Lab becomes a trusted engine for faster learning, better prototypes, and stronger commercialization decisions.
lululemon creates material platforms that are differentiated, scalable, and difficult for competitors to replicate.
Innovation moves faster from idea to proof of concept and from proof of concept to first commercial production.
New materials deliver clear guest-perceivable benefits in feel, function, performance, durability, or comfort.
Partnerships with machinery manufacturers, technology companies, mills, labs, and research institutions create meaningful technical advantage.
Material innovations are supported by strong data, clear testing, well-managed risk, and appropriate IP protection.
lululemon is recognized externally as a leader in advanced materials and manufacturing innovation.

Qualifications

Master's degree or PhD preferred in Textile Engineering, Materials Science,
